name: Soulsie Riff
tagline: A private gag-writer that spins a running in-joke into fresh dad-joke riffs, quietly.
description: Runs a small comedy bench devoted to one standing in-joke: hand it a line and it answers with riff after riff, leaning hard into groan-worthy dad humor. It never leaves your chat - nothing is posted, nobody is messaged, and the account the bit came from is left alone.
author: AdventureNLearn
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
